title: feat: complete ROADMAP P1–P4 development tasks
body:
Addresses the open ROADMAP items across Developer Experience, User Experience, Component Excellence, and Documentation priorities.

### Zod Discriminated Unions (P1.2)

Converted 12 category-level `z.union()` → `z.discriminatedUnion('type', [...])` across all schema files (layout, form, feedback, data-display, disclosure, overlay, navigation, complex, blocks, reports, views, theme). This gives TypeScript narrowing on `type` field and dramatically better autocompletion + error messages.

```typescript
// Before: generic union, no narrowing
export const LayoutSchema = z.union([DivSchema, SpanSchema, ...]);

// After: discriminated on 'type', TS narrows automatically
export const LayoutSchema = z.discriminatedUnion('type', [DivSchema, SpanSchema, ...]);
```

### CLI Scaffolding (P1.1, P1.4)

- **`objectui init`** now generates a complete buildable project: `package.json`, `vite.config.ts`, `tailwind.config.js`, `postcss.config.js`, `index.html`, `src/main.tsx`, `src/App.tsx`, `tsconfig.json`
- **`create-plugin`** template now includes a `.stories.tsx` file with Default + WithClassName variants

### Focus Management Hooks (P2.3)

Added `useFocusReturn` (capture/restore focus on mount/unmount) and `useRovingFocus` (arrow-key navigation for item lists) to `@object-ui/react`.

### Skeleton & State Primitives (P2.4, P3.1)

- **`view-skeleton.tsx`** — `GridSkeleton`, `KanbanSkeleton`, `FormSkeleton`, `ListSkeleton`, `ChartSkeleton`
- **`view-states.tsx`** — `DataLoadingState`, `DataEmptyState`, `DataErrorState` with ARIA roles, retry support

### Storybook Stories (P3.5)

Added stories for 10 plugin packages: grid, kanban, calendar, dashboard, form, charts, list, detail, timeline, gantt. Follows existing `SchemaRenderer` + JSON schema pattern.

### Documentation (P4.1, P4.2)

- **`content/docs/guide/deployment.md`** — Docker, Vercel, Railway, Netlify configs
- **`content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`** — 20+ schema types with annotated JSON examples

### ROADMAP Verification (P2.2)

Marked 4 items as complete after verifying: ObjectView is already plugin-based, Console uses `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, 14 plugins registered via side-effect imports, view tabs are schema-driven from `objectDef.list_views`.
